target_profile.system_boundary: Captured go.etcd.io/raft library: raft state machine, RawNode/Node adapters, quorum, configuration, log and Storage interface. Network transport, durable disk writes, application state machine and client completion are caller responsibilities.
protocol_contexts: Active simple or joint voter configuration
Log entry index and entry term
ownership: RawNode is thread-unsafe and caller-serialized; Node.run serializes its state-machine events.
selection_injection: Caller supplies Storage, IDs, recovered state and configuration choices; in-repository quorum and membership implementations are traced rather than treated as external.
unknowns: Authentication and transport fault enforcement are outside the captured library.

behaviors.protocol_context: One local raft instance; RawNode requires caller serialization
behaviors.trigger: Propose, Step, Campaign, Ready and Advance
legal_preconditions: Caller performs Ready storage/application duties; network responses identify their sender.
implementation_guards: RawNode rejects network-local messages and responses from unknown peers. Node applies corresponding filters in Step/run.
external_effects: Propose returns Step admission/error; Node waits for the Step result. This is not commit or application completion.
important_branches: Follower without a leader drops proposals; Node disables proposal reception while it has no leader. Cancellation can end the caller wait.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Routes proposal and replication messages to the serialized raft owner.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Routes campaigns and term-bearing messages to authority transition logic.

unknowns: Network authentication and downstream client completion are outside this library boundary.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term and currently installed progress/configuration
implementation_guards: Reject if local progress is absent or transfer is active; enforce uncommitted byte quota.
Configuration proposal validation uses pendingConfIndex, applied index and joint status unless disabled.
writes: Assign current term and consecutive indexes; append to unstable log.
external_effects: Broadcast MsgApp carrying predecessor index/term, entries and commit.
important_branches: Invalid configuration proposals can become empty normal entries; proposal acceptance does not activate membership.
Paused peer replication or unavailable log prefix may require snapshot/retry.

cross_activity_effects.A6: New entries and self-support await persistence processing.

existing_protections: Self-acknowledgement is queued after append; it does not immediately update Match.

behaviors.protocol_context: Follower receiving term-filtered MsgApp; index/entry-term history
implementation_guards: Match predecessor term before accepting; reject with hint on mismatch.
A conflicting entry at or below committed causes panic, not replacement.
writes: Append conflicting uncommitted suffix and commit at most min(message commit, last new index).
external_effects: Queue MsgAppResp for accepted last index, or committed index when predecessor is behind committed. Rejections also pass through the append barrier.

cross_activity_effects.A6: Successful processing establishes an in-memory prefix; response durability is separately delegated to Ready handling.

existing_protections: The committed-prefix shortcut does not accept an arbitrary uncommitted suffix.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.send and RawNode Ready/Advance; external storage worker
behaviors.protocol_context: Ready batch, current raft term, last entry index/term
behaviors.trigger: Queued vote/append response or unstable/HardState update
implementation_guards: MsgAppResp, MsgVoteResp and MsgPreVoteResp are separated into msgsAfterAppend.
Async response records current raft term and last unstable entry identity, including in-progress entries.
writes: acceptReady clears queues and marks unstable work in progress; this does not attest durable storage.
durable_effects: Actual persistence is a caller duty; the library emits work and completion messages, not disk writes.
external_effects: Async MsgStorageAppend carries responses for delivery after durable ordered writes.
Synchronous mode returns remote responses in Ready and defers self responses plus storage acknowledgements to Advance.
important_branches: Append messages may exist solely to release responses or persist HardState.
Async Advance is forbidden; local apply work uses a separate ordered destination.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Controls when self/peer support can legally be delivered and counted.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Controls publication of election votes and persisted term transitions.

unknowns: Synchronous same-batch message ordering differs between doc.go and the Ready interface comments; do not treat the weaker prose as settled permission.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current leader term and installed incoming/outgoing voter sets
implementation_guards: Require sender progress; MaybeUpdate monotonically increases Match.
Commit candidate must exceed current committed and its log term must equal current nonzero raft term.
reads: Per-peer Match; active voter sets; local log entry term.
writes: Update peer Match/Next and flow control; advance raftLog.committed on qualified index.
external_effects: Broadcast commit advance; release pending reads after current-term commit.
important_branches: Rejected/stale responses adjust or leave probing state; they do not establish successful Match.
Learner progress can update, but quorum iteration counts configured voters only.
Joint index is the minimum of both majority indexes.
existing_protections: Heartbeat replies mark activity and read acknowledgements, not replicated Match.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.Step, campaign, stepCandidate and role transitions
behaviors.protocol_context: Local raft term, role, vote and installed voter sets
behaviors.trigger: Election tick/Campaign; votes; higher-term input; quorum loss; leader transfer
implementation_guards: Campaign requires eligible nonlearner progress, no in-progress snapshot, and no unapplied committed configuration change.
Vote eligibility combines stored vote/known leader with lexicographic last-entry freshness.
PreVote and granted future PreVote responses do not immediately advance term; lease check may suppress vote requests.
writes: Role reset clears vote tallies, peer progress, transfer state and readOnly acknowledgements; only term change clears Vote.
Self Match resets to local last index, other Match to zero; log and committed prefix remain.
New leader appends a current-term empty entry.
important_branches: Lower-term messages normally return before role handling; old storage append responses may still acknowledge their snapshot.
PreCandidate counts only PreVoteResp; Candidate counts only VoteResp.
Quorum loss with CheckQuorum steps down; transfer pauses proposals and sends TimeoutNow only after transferee catch-up.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Rebuilds volatile support on role changes; current-term commit guard connects new support to retained history.
cross_activity_effects.A6: A higher raft term invalidates previously issued append-completion markers for entry stabilization. Step rejects their entry portion while preserving snapshot completion separately.

unknowns: PendingReadIndexMessages is not cleared by reset, unlike readOnly; it is later reconfirmed through releasePendingReadIndexMessages after current-term commit. Effects across membership transitions merit focused investigation.

behaviors.protocol_context: Storage response raft term plus entry index/log term; snapshot index separately
implementation_guards: Current-term entry completion requires unstable entry index and term match.
Lower-term completion does not stabilize entries; included snapshot is still processed.
writes: Matching stableTo trims unstable prefix; snapshot completion clears matching snapshot and advances applied via max(index, oldApplied).

cross_activity_effects.A1: Async application eligibility uses unstable offset after this completion.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Entry completion is context-qualified while committed snapshot completion can survive term change.

existing_protections: New-term HardState-only append can carry last unstable identity and provide a fresh ordered completion.
unknowns: Response consumption after log replacement and overlapping snapshot completion needs separate history coverage.

behaviors.protocol_context: Applied configuration entry and incoming/outgoing voter sets
behaviors.trigger: Caller applies committed ConfChange, or recovery restores ConfState
implementation_guards: Simple change alters at most one voter; joint transitions preserve outgoing voters until LeaveJoint.
Nonempty voter requirement and voter/learner/progress invariants are checked.
writes: Install new Config and Progress; retained peers preserve copied Match; new peers start Match zero.
Outgoing voters retain progress; staged learners become learners after leaving joint.
external_effects: Leader recomputes commit under updated quorum; sends append/probes and may abort removed transferee.
important_branches: Removed/demoted leader steps down only with StepDownOnRemoval; absent local progress separately rejects proposals.
Applied-progress callback can propose automatic joint exit.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Changes which existing Match values qualify and can advance commitment without a new acknowledgement.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Changes campaigning eligibility and may remove current authority.

unknowns: Cancellation wording differs between RawNode ApplyConfChange and doc.go; a specific check must establish its selected API contract.

behaviors.execution_owner: RawNode.readyWithoutAccept / acceptReady and raft applied callbacks
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed, applying and applied indexes; selected storage mode
behaviors.trigger: Ready production and storage application completion
implementation_guards: Do not expose committed entries alongside outstanding snapshot; limit outstanding application bytes.
Async mode limits application to stable prefix; synchronous mode can include unstable committed entries subject to caller Ready duties.
writes: Ready acceptance advances applying; Advance or MsgStorageApplyResp advances applied and releases quota.

important_branches: MsgStorageApplyResp uses term zero because committed entries survive terms.

cross_activity_effects.A4: Applied-progress callback can initiate automatic joint exit.

behaviors.protocol_context: Persisted HardState/ConfState and log; snapshot index/term/configuration
implementation_guards: loadState bounds commit by available log.
Snapshot restoration requires follower state and recipient inclusion; obsolete snapshots are ignored.
writes: Restart loads term/vote/commit, reconstructs membership and starts follower.
Nonobsolete snapshot either fast-forwards matching log commit or replaces unstable history and reconstructs membership.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Preserves/reconstructs committed prefix while volatile peer support is rebuilt.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Restart starts without known leader, using saved term/vote and recovered eligibility.

behaviors.protocol_context: ReadOnlySafe request context, captured commit index and current voter configuration
implementation_guards: Non-singleton leader defers reads until current-term commit.
Safe mode collects unique peer acknowledgements by request context and evaluates installed voter quorum.
writes: Capture committed index; self-ack; queue request context; drain prefix through acknowledged context.
external_effects: Emit ReadState locally or MsgReadIndexResp; follower accepts exactly one entry carrying request context.
important_branches: Singleton bypasses heartbeat round; lease mode relies on configured lease assumptions.
Duplicate context is ignored by addRequest; caller must correlate unique requests.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Ready ReadState still requires caller application progress before serving a local read.

unknowns: Safety of acknowledgement reuse across membership change requires its own applicability and history investigation.

behaviors.protocol_context: Currently installed incoming/outgoing voter maps on the invoking raft instance
behaviors.trigger: stepLeader evaluates singleton shortcut for MsgReadIndex
implementation_guards: Returns true exactly when incoming voter count is one and outgoing voter count is zero.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Supplies the predicate used to skip read quorum communication; it establishes cardinality only, not the invoking node membership.

behaviors.protocol_context: StateLeader dispatch with a singleton installed voter configuration
implementation_guards: IsSingleton is checked before current-term committed-entry gating and without checking local Progress membership.
external_effects: Directly append local ReadState for local requests or send MsgReadIndexResp for forwarded requests; no heartbeat quorum round in this branch.
existing_protections: StepDownOnRemoval=true changes removed leader to follower and prevents this leader branch.
Higher-term message also causes step-down, but the new singleton voter no longer sends replication messages to the removed node.
unknowns: The emitted read-state endpoint is distinct from application-served read completion.

facts.meaning: A local append path has queued a MsgAppResp for the indicated index; it has not thereby persisted entries or delivered support.
facts.validity_context: The local raft state when send queues the response; successful follower append or leader self append.
facts.durability: Volatile queued work. Legal delivery depends on the Ready/storage contract.
facts.recovery: Queued messages are not recovered as messages; restart reconstructs protocol state and can regenerate replies.
unknowns: No execution has established a concrete durable write or message delivery.

facts.meaning: Within the current progress generation, the leader records the highest accepted successful append response index for a peer, or the local last index assigned by role reset for itself. This is an implementation support value, not an independently observed durable disk prefix.
facts.validity_context: Current Progress object; preserved peers can retain it through configuration activation, while reset replaces progress values.
facts.recovery: Peer values are reset; self value is initialized from local history.
unknowns: Its interpretation as durable support relies on legal response production/delivery and elected-leader history; no direct execution evidence yet.

facts.meaning: Local raftLog.committed marks a prefix selected by current-term quorum advancement, leader commit propagation, snapshot adoption or persisted-state reconstruction. It does not itself assert application or client completion.
facts.validity_context: Local log history retained across role/term resets; peer support aggregation is configuration-dependent.
facts.durability: Emitted in HardState; actual persisted completion is separate.
facts.recovery: loadState validates saved commit bounds; snapshots supply committed index.
unknowns: Follower heartbeat producer/consumer is covered in overview but not yet a separate fact-producing Behavior; broader producer decomposition is pending.

facts.meaning: RawNode has issued a local append-completion marker identifying a captured raft term and last unstable entry index/log term. Issuance alone does not establish write completion; the caller may return it only after the associated ordered storage work completes.

identity.origin: actual response attached to a RawNode-produced append message

facts.validity_context: Eligible for entry stabilization only in its captured raft term and when the entry identity still matches unstable state; snapshot completion has a distinct lifetime.
facts.durability: Volatile protocol marker; physical write completion is an external prerequisite, not guaranteed by issuance.
facts.recovery: Not recovered as a marker after restart; new Ready production regenerates work from recovered state.
unknowns: Snapshot-bearing responses are outside the initial focused proposition.
Identical tuples can be emitted by different append work items; an execution must independently identify their origin rather than correlate on tuple alone.

facts.meaning: The installed configuration has exactly one incoming voter and no outgoing voters. This establishes no assertion that the querying raft instance is that voter.
facts.validity_context: At IsSingleton evaluation; invalidated by configuration activation or configuration reconstruction.
facts.durability: Derived from volatile installed configuration; persistence is through caller-managed configuration snapshots and applied entries.
facts.recovery: ConfState reconstruction restores the maps whose lengths are queried.

surfaces.entry_point: Synchronous Ready persistence and message ordering
surfaces.reason: doc.go permits same-batch overlap whereas Ready.Messages and RawNode comments require Entries persisted before Messages. This is conflicting contract evidence, not an implementation violation.

readOnly acknowledgements are context-keyed and consumed with current voters; reset replaces that state but retains the separate first-commit pending queue. Need legal membership/authority history and normative scope before a focused question.
RawNode comment permits no call when rejecting while doc.go describes calling with NodeID zero; selected API and application duties must be reconciled.

surfaces.entry_point: Storage implementation and external durable/apply workers
surfaces.reason: Storage interface and core consumers read; concrete MemoryStorage mutations and worker implementations require expansion if selected. Actual disk durability and client response lie outside the library.

formation.explanation: A serialized RawNode caller or node.run admits Propose into raft.Step. Followers may forward; candidates or leaderless followers drop. A leader assigns term/index, appends unstable entries, queues a self acknowledgement and replicates MsgApp with predecessor identity. Followers validate the predecessor, refuse committed conflicts, truncate only uncommitted suffixes, and queue append responses. send separates these responses from immediately sendable messages. In async mode ordered durable append work releases responses; synchronous Ready/Advance splits remote and self delivery under caller persistence duties. The leader term-filters replies, requires sender progress, updates Match monotonically, computes the majority-supported index (both majorities for joint membership), and advances only if that index has the current term. Commit is propagated in appends; heartbeats cap commit at the recipient Match. Followers cap append commit at their matched request suffix. Ready exposes committed work with snapshot and application-size guards; async mode additionally requires local stabilization. Applied callbacks are distinct from Ready acceptance and client completion. Propose success promises no commitment.

context.explanation: Authority belongs to a raft instance in a term and installed voter configuration. Election ticks or Campaign require promotability and no unapplied committed configuration change. PreVote can probe the next term without changing current term/vote; real campaigning increments term and queues durable self-vote support. Vote recipients check previous vote/known leader and candidate last-entry freshness. Candidates tally only the response type matching their phase, using configured voter majorities. Winning real election resets progress and appends a current-term empty entry. Higher-term messages generally install follower state, with explicit pre-vote and lease exceptions; stale messages are normally ignored. CheckQuorum may remove leadership; transfer pauses proposals and waits for transferee catch-up. Membership activates through caller application of committed configuration entries, using simple/joint transitions and retained progress. Restart reconstructs saved term/vote/commit and membership but starts follower with no leader. Snapshot acceptance checks obsolescence, follower state and recipient membership before restoring history/configuration or fast-forwarding matching commit.

connection.explanation: Role reset discards vote tallies and remote Match, retains local history/commit, initializes self Match from that history and rebuilds readOnly acknowledgements. A new current-term entry plus quorum/current-term commitment reconnects retained history to new leadership. Configuration activation can reinterpret retained Match and call maybeCommit without a fresh reply. Old queued responses can survive emission, so consumers enforce term filtering; storage append completion additionally matches entry index/log term before trimming unstable memory. Snapshot completion from an older term remains processed, and application responses have term zero, reflecting committed state that outlives authority. Pending read requests awaiting first current-term commit survive reset separately from readOnly acknowledgement state: they are released only after a current-term commit and then enter the selected read confirmation mechanism. Safe reads correlate heartbeat acknowledgements by context and installed voters; returned ReadState is still subject to caller application progress. These mechanisms separate volatile support, established local decisions, durable state and externally served results. The singleton read shortcut consumes only voter cardinality, whereas configuration activation may retain a removed leader role when StepDownOnRemoval is false. Therefore the local-voter identity needed for self-certification is a distinct relationship from retained role and singleton cardinality; StepDownOnRemoval provides an alternate protection.

open_details: Reconcile doc.go same-batch persistence/send overlap with stricter Ready interface wording before selecting synchronous driver permissions.
ReadIndex acknowledgement eligibility across configuration activation and retained pending reads needs a local discriminator.
Detailed disk failure, crash recovery and application transaction behavior are outside the captured library contract; MemoryStorage and bootstrap implementation variants remain partly unread.
Fact producer decomposition is partial: heartbeat commit and read support require separate Behaviors before a Candidate depends on them.
core_overview.rationale: Source-grounded backbone for both core relationships and their connection, with supporting membership, recovery and Ready/application paths. This is an understanding judgment, not a correctness result or exhaustive map.
